Remarkable results. RetroFix breathed new life into my grandfathers naval journal that contained photos from the 1920’s. Some of them were in bad shape … before I found them they had suffered water damage, mildew, discoloration, cracks, creases. You get the picture. 

THIS PROGRAM REVIVED THEM. My brother who is preparing them to exhibit in a D.C. naval museum curation, was blown away by how absolutely realistic the restoration was completed. Every one of the photos STILL LOOKED LIKE MY GRANDFATHER not some weird alien ai version, but actually him. And the colorized mode was incredible. The moments came back to life for us. Thank you. 

What it’s worth, been graphic designer and used Photoshop for 20 plus years in many different capacities , and I will say RetroFix is way better for this kind of photo restoration Work. It is fast, intuitive and produces incredible results. Their tools, and AI algorithms are far more developed and on point. I would use this program over say, Photoshop any given day.

To attempt similar restoration using Photoshop, you are referred to complete an almost 50 step, unnecessarily overly complex & useless tutorial, that yields results not even HALF as nice as RetroFix. 

NO thanks! 

Not so long as RetroFix is available.😂THANK YOU!!!🙏🏻

AI. The AI facility for combining 2 portrait pictures into one is outstanding. Not tried the other features so have based my rating on this feature alone.

Update - since my last review I’ve now had the opportunity try some of the other features, in particular, the ‘recreate’, ‘enhance’, ‘colorize’ and Descratch’ functions. I put a photo of my great grandmother into the ‘recreate’ function, taken back in 1893. It was an old black and white which had lost most of its original definition. What came out was a beautiful recreation of the original photo in colour, providing intricate detail on the 1800 century blouse which was only hinted at in the original photo. I did the same with another great grandmother and it actually created finished chair and table detail that had been cut off the original black & white photo and brought to life the original pattern on the dress that was only hinted at. Once again, I’m blown away by the result. 👍🏻

However, my revisit to the ‘combine feature’ left me unimpressed and disappointed as the backgrounds were pretty disappointing and the likeness had been lost. The backgrounds had a limited generation, incorporating two people onto an Americano street backdrop or American car setting. Given I’m British and don’t live in 1930, the photos lacked the brilliance compared with original photos I previously produced, I would now describe this feature as a big flop. The likeness wasn’t as good as the original and now incorporates the caption ‘generated by AI’ on the bottom of every photo it creates (as if we didn’t know). 👎

Taken on balance, I would still give this program a 5 star rating but only for features other than the ‘Combine’ and ‘Animate’. 
NB. If you like hand waving and buck teeth smiles then go ahead and animate to your hearts content.

Review Update:

It’s always nice to hear from the creators of an app. Specially when they address you with a clear, workable solution delivered by nice words.
Your product is one among the best in its genre. The fact is that your team is very creative. The weekly subscription that you suggest is a good choice. Then again the fact remains that if one forgets about deactivating the subscription, it will automatically go on. This is a common problem with subscriptions
when one is absent minded like yours truly.
What about if you present a different perspective? Let’s say that you offer a basic plan with one editor option from your menu for a price. Then, as the user gets the liking of the app (which in your case is very easy, since your app is addictive) Then the user can choose to keep on buying the other options as he builds his own editing desk.

Just the fact that you kindly share a nice demo makes us feel that you are a better team than many others out there. I could keep on doing with it at this level, but I’d rather like to invest and to encourage you from a different level to reward your creativity.
Have a great day ahead!
